चोष, अस्, m. sucking, suction; burning (of the
skin), heat, inflammation, dryness; drying up.
चोष चोष, &c. See चूष्, p. 329, col. 2.
चोष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be sucked out; [cf. चूष्य.]

चोस्क चोस्क, अस्, m. a horse peculiar to the
Indus district; a horse of a particular and good breed.

चोष्कूयमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. bestowing, giv-
ing, (Sāy. = प्रयच्छत्, Ṛg-veda
